name: Quantum Fabrix
description: Quantum Fabrix (QFX) is a University of Oxford spin-out developing miniaturised atom sources (MAS) for trapped-ion quantum computers, enabling sub-millisecond ion loading and modular scalable quantum hardware. Operating from Begbroke Science Park in Oxford, QFX supplies critical hardware components to trapped-ion quantum computer manufacturers. The company also develops SrROCK, a strontium-based quantum timing and sensing component.

products.name: Miniature Atom Source (MAS)
products.description: Compact atom source enabling sub-millisecond ion loading for trapped-ion quantum processors, enabling modular and scalable quantum hardware design

products.name: SrROCK
products.description: Strontium-based quantum timing and sensing component for precision measurement applications

news.title: Quantum Fabrix raises GBP 2M seed for miniaturised atom sources for trapped-ion quantum computers
news.excerpt: Oxford spin-out QFX closed a GBP 2M seed round led by Paul Graham (Y Combinator co-founder) and UK government quantum programme funding in October 2025. The company's miniature atom source technology enables sub-millisecond ion loading, targeting supply to trapped-ion quantum computer manufacturers for modular scalable systems.
